links.comparator_used: Initial default prompt to generate PEMs with no reading-level instruction, versus a follow-up readability-optimized prompt asking for a 6th-grade reading level
links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated patient education materials (grade level)
links.effect: Initial vs FRO grade level: ChatGPT 10.8 to 8.3, Copilot 12.2 to 11.2, Llama 13.2 to 9.3 (p < 0.001). AI PEMs were not statistically easier to read than AAO PEMs (8.0 Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level).
links.tradeoff: Most outputs stayed above the recommended 6th-grade level. A subjective review of one subtopic found AI content had less nuance than AAO, especially in areas of clinical uncertainty.
links.quote: While initially prompted ChatGPT, Copilot, and Llama outputs were 10.8, 12.2, and 13.2, respectively, FRO prompting significantly improved readability to 8.3 for ChatGPT, 11.2 for Copilot, and 9.3 for Llama (p < 0.001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint via follow-up readability-optimized prompt
